title: validation-emission: Close 15-of-35 §16 validation code emission gaps (rolls in S-23)
description: Feature P2-16. vb_validate/src/lib.rs declares 49 ValidationError variants (35 master §16 + 14 extras), but only 20 are ever emitted. 15 missing: SecretNotDeclared (folds into UnknownReference), SecretResultLeak (explicitly disabled), 11 Invalid* body-shape variants, PayloadTooLarge, plus 2 missing ResourceLimits field checks. Master §16 requires all 35 codes to be emitted. This bead closes the gap per code: SecretNotDeclared (split off the $secrets.* check in validate_declared to emit SecretNotDeclared), SecretResultLeak (re-enable the taint check for Finish{result} when ResourceContract::allows_secret_results == false), 11 Invalid* body-shape (add 11 per-primitive validators in vb_validate/src/gates.rs or remove the variants), PayloadTooLarge (add to validate_resource_limits), ResourceLimits (add checks for the missing 2 fields; rolls in S-23). S-23 is a sub-bullet of P2-16 — do NOT file S-23 as a separate bead.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit every validation error code defined in master §16 (all 35 codes reachable from the validate pipeline)
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently fold one code into another (e.g., SecretNotDeclared into UnknownReference) without a typed emission

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a workflow uses $secrets.foo with no `secrets: [foo]` declaration
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit ValidationError::SecretNotDeclared (not fold into UnknownReference)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a workflow has a Finish{result} that reads a Secret-tainted slot and ResourceContract::allows_secret_results == false
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit ValidationError::SecretResultLeak (currently disabled)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a workflow uses a primitive with an invalid body shape (e.g., for_each with no body)
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit the matching Invalid* variant (11 of these)

unwanted.condition: IF a validation code is declared in vb_validate/src/lib.rs but never emitted
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT keep it; it must be emitted OR removed (no dead codes)
unwanted.because: Master §16: 35 codes are the contract; dead codes are documentation lies

preconditions: Workflow YAML parses under the strict profile
All 11 Invalid* body-shape primitives are known: set, do, choose, for_each, together, collect, reduce, repeat, wait, ask, finish
postconditions: All 35 master §16 codes are emitted by some validator
proptest assertion: every variant declared in vb_validate::ValidationError is emitted by at least one test fixture
invariants: No silent code folding: each error has a unique code (0x0X00) and a unique variant
All 18 ResourceContract fields are checked (rolls in S-23)

secret_result_leak_is_emitted: a workflow with Finish{result = Secret-tainted slot} and allows_secret_results: false emits SecretResultLeak
all_11_invalid_body_shape_variants_are_emitted: proptest with 11 fixtures, one per primitive, each emits the matching Invalid* variant
payload_too_large_is_emitted: a workflow with a payload > max_result_bytes emits PayloadTooLarge
error: no_unemitted_codes: a proptest walks all 35 codes, asserting each is emitted by at least one fixture
duplicate_code_assignment_fails_proptest: if two variants share the same code (0x0X00), the proptest fails with a 'duplicate code' error
no_silent_folding: if SecretNotDeclared folds into UnknownReference (the bug), the proptest fails with the specific folded path
edge: all_18_resource_contract_fields_checked: proptest over 18 ResourceContract fields, asserting each is checked by validate_resource_limits (rolls in S-23)

files: crates/vb_validate/src/gates.rs (the per-primitive validators; 11 Invalid* go here or are removed)
crates/vb_validate/src/lib.rs::validate_resource_limits (where PayloadTooLarge and the 2 missing field checks go; rolls in S-23)
patterns: Pattern: existing validators emit typed ValidationError variants with stable codes (0x0X00)
Pattern: ResourceContract field checks follow a `match contract.field { Some(v) if v > limit => PayloadTooLarge, _ => Ok(()) }` pattern
questions: For the 11 Invalid* body-shape variants, is it better to add validators or remove the variants? (Spec: prefer adding validators; only remove if a primitive is truly not in the IR.)
For the 2 missing ResourceContract fields, are they `max_together_branches` and `max_result_bytes`, or different fields? (Spec: S-23 sub-bullet; the answer is documented in S-23.)

security_failures.failure: A workflow smuggles a Secret result via Finish{result = Secret slot} because SecretResultLeak is disabled
security_failures.prevention: Re-enable the taint check; emit SecretResultLeak

usability_failures.failure: Workflow author gets a generic 'InvalidWorkflow' error with no specific code, can't tell what's wrong
usability_failures.prevention: All 35 codes are emitted; the error message includes the code and the path

data_integrity_failures.failure: Two error variants are silently folded into one (e.g., SecretNotDeclared into UnknownReference), losing the security signal
data_integrity_failures.prevention: Each variant has its own emission path; no folding
data_integrity_failures.test_for_it: no_silent_folding (assertion: each declared variant has a unique emitter)

integration_failures.failure: External monitoring tool counts emitted error codes; missing emissions skew the count
integration_failures.prevention: All 35 codes are emitted; the count is stable
